_role: C: driver cancelled for own reason (car broke down), reason field says rider_no_show

dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$6.00 as a no-show. I was downstairs and told the driver I was coming. I think the charge is wrong, please look at the chat.

chat_logs.content: I'm at Blk 405 bus stop, blue Avante.
Sorry, my car just started smoking and the engine is overheating. I have to stop and get it towed, I cannot do your trip.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $6.00 applied.
I'm at the bus stop now, I can see you with the bonnet up. Why am I being charged?

app_events.details: Rider R-7745 booked trip RYDE-CS-003 from Blk 405 Yishun Avenue 6 to Woodlands Checkpoint. Pickup 09:00.
Driver D-1196 (Rashid Bin Ismail, Hyundai Avante (SNF 4417 B)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 3 min free wait period ends at 09:01.
Free 3-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Cancel pressed by driver D-1196. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$6.00 charged to rider payment method (e-wallet).
Driver D-1196 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 08:58:00 and the cancel was pressed by the driver at 09:08:00 (10-minute wait, which on its own is past the 8-minute threshold). But the driver's own chat at 09:06:00 says the car was smoking and overheating and he could not do the trip, and the rider had replied at 09:02 that he was coming down. The cancellation was made for the driver's own reasons, so the fee does not apply even though the reason field says rider_no_show. The S$6.00 is refunded to the rider.
